title: 第1章 你的神不要你了第2章 预言书
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: “所以，安森主教，按照您的观点，魔导科技的发展就是在亵渎神明？”
“正是如此！尤其是你！洛加里斯，你以往的理论严重——”安森主教刚要继续，就被打断。
“那么，安森主教，我必须遗憾地指出——”洛加里斯摊了摊手“你的智商，恐怕还不如一只岩角羊。”
圣阿卡迪亚学院，公开辩论场。
洛加里斯·维斯特，这位学院有史以来最年轻的教授，正用他那冷静到几乎刻薄的语调对对面的圣教人员进行着不留情面的人身攻击。
“至少岩角羊还懂得通过吃草来维持生命，而你，安森主教，你似乎只会吸入空气并将其转化成垃圾从嘴里排泄出来。”
洛加里斯那平静的语气像是在陈述一个客观事实
全场死寂。
所有学生都兴奋地看着这一幕。前排几个胆大的已经拿出了留影石悄悄记录这段精彩的“学术攻击”，准备当作今日饭间与同学之间的资谈。
安森主教深吸一口气，强压下胸中的怒火，声音低沉而充满威胁：“洛加里斯·维斯特！你别以为成为了圣阿卡迪亚的学院教授就能为所欲为了！你迟早会为今天的话付出代价的。”
“代价？”洛加里斯挑了挑眉，“你是在威胁一位五阶魔导师吗？还是说，你打算亲自和我进行一场学者之间的战斗。”
洛加里斯毫不掩饰自己的不屑。
台下传来几声压抑不住的笑声。
嚣张！赤裸裸的嚣张！
安森主教一口气没上来，只能强行挽颜道：“神会惩戒你这个亵渎者的！”
“惩戒？”洛加里斯冷笑，“您是指像上次那样，派十名圣骑士来拜访我的研究室，结果被我的防御阵困住三天三夜的那种惩戒吗？”
“说真的，如果你们圣教廷真有那么强大的神力，为什么不直接让神降下神罚？”
“哦，抱歉，我差点忘了——你们的神已经快要一百年没有回应过任何人的祈祷了。”
前排的几个学生对视一眼，似乎意识到洛加里斯要说什么，悄悄往后挪了挪椅子，试图让自己远离这场即将爆发的风暴中心。
“换句话说，你的神早就不要你了。”洛加里斯说出了这句对教廷人员堪称禁忌的话。
安森主教的眼睛猛然瞪大，他张着嘴，却发不出任何声音，嘴唇剧烈地颤抖着，最后双眼一翻，直挺挺地向后倒了下去。
“主教大人！”
“快！快叫治疗牧师！”
现场瞬间乱作一团。
洛加里斯则像个没事人一样，整理了一下自己的衣领，在周围学生敬畏的目光中，转身离场。
“天呐……这是洛加里斯教授这个月气晕的第五个圣职人员了吧？”
“是第六个！上周教授还在图书馆还气晕了一个来找麻烦的修士！”
“太帅了……这就是圣阿卡迪亚历史上最年轻的五阶魔导师吗？不仅学术无敌，嘴也这么毒！”
“听说教授才22岁，你说，教授有心上人吗？”
“好像没有，不过……我倒是听说，教授在学院念书的时候，和瑟薇娅公主殿下的关系可不一般……据说两人曾经在图书馆里通宵研究魔导理论，关系好得很……”
“嗯？我怎么听说教授好像和公主殿下势同水火啊……”
“闭嘴！你想被教授听到吗？上次有个学长在教授面前提起公主殿下，后来每节课他都被教授抽起来提问！”
议论声被洛加里斯甩在身后。
content_en:
"So, Bishop Anson, according to your point of view, the development of magic technology is blasphemous?"
"That's right! Especially you! Logaris, your past theories are serious-" Bishop Anson was about to continue, but was interrupted.
"Then, Bishop Anson, I must point out with regret -" Logaris spread his hands, "I'm afraid your IQ is not as good as a rockhorn sheep."
College of St. Arcadia, venue for public debate.
Logaris West, the youngest professor in the history of the college, was using his calm and almost mean tone to make merciless personal attacks on the Holy Cult personnel across from him.
"At least the rockhorn sheep know how to sustain life by eating grass, but you, Bishop Anson, seem to only inhale air and turn it into garbage and excrete it from your mouth."
Logaris' calm tone seemed to be stating an objective fact.
The whole place was dead silent.
All the students looked at this scene excitedly. A few brave people in the front row had already taken out photo stones and secretly recorded this wonderful "academic attack", preparing to discuss it with their classmates during today's meal.
Bishop Anson took a deep breath, suppressed the anger in his chest, and his voice was low and full of threats: "Logaris West! Don't think that you can do whatever you want by becoming a professor at St. Arcadia's College! Sooner or later, you will pay the price for what you said today."
"The price?" Logaris raised his eyebrows, "Are you threatening a fifth-level magister? Or are you planning to personally engage in a battle between scholars with me?"
Logaris made no secret of his disdain.
Several bursts of uncontrollable laughter came from the audience.
Arrogant! Naked arrogance!
Bishop Anson didn't even come up for a breath, so he could only forcefully say: "God will punish you, a blasphemer!"
"Punishment?" Logaris sneered, "Are you referring to the kind of punishment like last time when ten paladins were sent to visit my research room, only to be trapped by my defense formation for three days and three nights?"
"Seriously, if your Holy See really has such powerful divine power, why don't you just ask God to impose divine punishment?"
"Oh, sorry, I almost forgot - your god hasn't answered anyone's prayers in almost a hundred years."
Several students in the front row looked at each other, as if they realized what Logaris was going to say, and quietly moved their chairs back, trying to keep themselves away from the center of the impending storm.
"In other words, your god no longer wants you." Logaris said these words that were taboo for members of the Holy See.
"You!"
Bishop Anson's eyes suddenly widened. He opened his mouth, but could not make any sound. His lips trembled violently. Finally, his eyes rolled up and he fell straight back.
"Your Majesty Bishop!"
"Quick! Call the healing priest!"
The scene instantly became chaotic.
Logaris, as if nothing happened, straightened his collar and turned to leave amid the awed gazes of the students around him.
"Oh my god...is this the fifth cleric that Professor Logaris has fainted this month?"
"It's the sixth one! Last week, the professor even knocked out a monk who was looking for trouble in the library!"
"So handsome... Is this the youngest fifth-level magister in the history of Saint Arcadia? Not only is he invincible academically, he is also so poisonous!"
"I heard that the professor is only 22 years old. Do you think the professor has a sweetheart?"
"It seems not, but... I heard that when the professor was studying in the academy, he had an unusual relationship with Princess Serviya... It is said that the two of them once stayed up all night studying magic theory in the library, and they had a very good relationship..."
"Huh? Why did I hear that the professor seems to be on the same level as Her Royal Highness the Princess..."
"Shut up! Do you want to be heard by the professor? Last time a senior mentioned Her Royal Highness in front of the professor, and then he was whipped up by the professor to ask questions in every class!"
The discussion was left behind by Logaris.
